typographyDecision: Preserve runtime Inter, Noto Sans SC, system-ui, sans-serif and unitless line-height 1.5 as DTCG. Native text styles remain snapshot metadata; do not infer installed fonts or collapse style/weight/lineHeight into FLOAT.
legacyToolingDecision: Deprecated as a production generator: historical build-local.py and validate-kit.py rewrite CSS, QA and ZIP and assume an unavailable home-directory image store. Do not run. Historical evidence remains pinned to historicalCommit. Assets are now inherited from accepted PR #16; this design pipeline does not rewrite them or claim their budget validation.
integrationNote: PR #16 is merged. Component export/props/blob evidence is re-pinned in component-mappings.json. Token decisions retain the original baseCommit comparison; inherited assets and font declarations are unchanged against integrationCommit.
